visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Box wider than the screen
visualizerParams.problemDescription: This box is meant to be 280px wide in total, but with its padding and border it is wider and pushes the page sideways. Make width include padding and border.
visualizerParams.buggyCode: Card

solution.code: Card
solution.explanation: By default width sets only the content area, and padding and border are added on top: 280 + 40 + 8 = 328px. box-sizing: border-box makes width the total size, which is much easier to plan.

checks.label: The card is 280px wide in total
